title: Nuclear Waste Disposal Drum
description: The &3Nuclear Waste Disposal Drum&r is used to decay &3RBMK&r nuclear waste. The decayed nuclear waste can then be used with a &3FEL&r and &3SILEX&r to obtain some rare elements, such as &6Bismuth&r.
&2The drum also emmits radiation when theres fuel inside it.&r
Later on, the &3Radiation-Powered Engine&r is a more reliable way of decaying rbmk fuel as you get guaranteed consistent decay times. Additionally it also provides power and doesnt emmit radiation.
&2Blueprints can be found in structures, purchased through Bobmazon or made in a Precision Assembler.
